events.title: The September 2026 Security Update Review
events.summary: Whelp, here we are. Deep into the new normal. With nearly 1,000 CVEs coming out from Microsoft and a healthy release from Adobe as well, there’s a phrase from my military days that comes to mind: embrace the suck. Take an extended break from your regularly scheduled activities as we take a look at the latest security patches from Adobe and Microsoft. If you’d rather watch the full video recap covering the entire release, you can check it out here: Adobe Patches for September 2026 For the first part of the August release, Adobe released 10 bulletins addressing 172 unique CVEs in Adobe ColdFusi…

claims.text: CISA lists CVE-2024-21412, CVE-2026-75650, CVE-2026-81963, CVE-2026-85880 and 1 more as exploited in the wild.
CVE-2026-96207 is rated 10.0 (critical) under CVSS 3.1 by the CNA that assigned it, the highest of the 2416 scored CVEs here.
FIRST's EPSS puts the chance of CVE-2024-21412 being exploited in the next 30 days at 99%, the highest of the 2416 CVEs here.
A fix for Microsoft.DiaSymReader.Native (NuGet) is published in 18.9.0-beta1.26405.2, per GHSA-527h-q9f6-p7qx.
A fix for Microsoft.AspNetCore.Server.IISIntegration (NuGet) is published in 11.0.0-rc.1, 8.0.31, 9.0.20 and 10.0.12, per GHSA-8cp2-47hg-mfgh.
A fix for MessagePack (NuGet) is published in 2.5.303 and 3.1.9, per GHSA-qhrr-8q5h-9q3h.

events.title: Critical Adobe Commerce & Magento Open Source Zero-Day Under Active Exploitation (CVE-2026-75650)
events.summary: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source are affected by a critical zero-day vulnerability (CVE-2026-75650) that is actively exploited, allowing attackers to inject malicious content via the template engine.
events.why_it_matters: The vulnerability has a CVSS score of 10.0 and is listed on the KEV, indicating it is a high-risk, actively exploited flaw. Defenders should immediately patch Adobe Commerce and Magento installations to prevent exploitation.
